payload.run_condition: One invocation late in a long multi-skill session, synthesizing an already-ratified scope into a roughly 25,000-character PRD with 61 user stories across seven template sections; the defective statement was one clause in the Implementation Decisions section; it survived publication uncaught by any step in the run and surfaced two user turns later, only when the user requested an authority check during the following skill.
payload.workaround_taken: The PRD body was re-verified against docs/adr, docs/design, and docs/principles after the user asked whether the carried-forward decisions aligned with them, then corrected in place on the published issue before any child issue was created.
